kuytu.title: Kuytu | Sanctuary of Whispers
kuytu.quote: "The world goes silent, Kuytu listens to you."

what.title: What is Kuytu | Sanctuary of Whispers?
what.p1: There are hundreds of people we pass by during the day, hundreds of words we swallow down, and endless feelings that blend into the darkness. Most of the time we go unnoticed. And most of the time, we fail to notice others.
what.p2: So, where do these lost moments go? This app is the sanctuary for those ownerless words and overlooked details. A silent digital diary where you don't have to raise your voice, where you aren't judged, and which belongs solely to you.

how.title: How It Works?
how.f1_desc: Turn inward amidst the chaos. Answer questions prepared for you or create your own to face your inner self. When writing feels too heavy, just turn on the microphone and release your burdens with voice whispers into the void.
how.f2_desc: Transform your raw words into a literary masterpiece. Write your own poem straight from the heart, or let Kuytu's AI 'Poetry Engine' craft a flawless piece for you. Sprinkle this solitude like stardust onto the streets of 'His' if you wish.
how.f3_desc: Don't look at your past as ordinary journal lists, but as a universe made of stars. Discover your memories glowing in the dark and let AI deeply analyze your mood. Embark on a journey of profound inner awareness.
how.f4_desc: Sometimes you just want to scream without an identity. Whisper the things piling up inside you into the universe, by writing or speaking. In these echoes that will vanish in the wind after 24 hours, connect with lonely souls looking at the same sky.
how.f5_desc: The record of hidden beauties you leave to the world without anyone seeing, without expecting applause. A hand reaching out to a stray animal or a slight smile... All these silent kindnesses accumulate on Fridays and echo in the sky.
how.f6_desc: Step into the literary world of invisible spirits and have deep conversations with them. Let them analyze your mood. If you are a Plus member, draw three Tarot cards and unveil the mysteries of your past, present, and future with unique mystical readings!

privacy.title: A Friend Who Listens But Keeps Your Secret
privacy.p1: The most important thing for us is your security.
privacy.p2: All the whispers you write are not uploaded to cloud servers or areas where others can read them.
privacy.p3: All your records are solely on your device, under your control. Only your poems –if you wish– mix into the air anonymously like stardust.
privacy.quote: The world goes silent, Kuytu listens to you.

his.quote: Step into a mysterious universe woven with unspoken whispers, lanterns of sorrow, and telepathic bonds.

what.title: What is His?
what.p1: His is a judgment-free and completely anonymous inner sanctuary where words and emotions blend mystically. The loneliness or euphoria you feel echoes with other souls here.
what.p2: Blow the exhaustion of the day into a lantern, chat with spiritual beings, or unravel the secrets of oracle cards. His is not just an app; it is a spiritual ritual where you return to your own truth.
what.p3: Now opening the doors to a more mystical universe. You can freely share your mood with your own identity, retreat to Kuytu to leave anonymous whispers, or open your soul to the universe with telepathic lanterns.

features.title: What Can You Do?
features.kuytu_desc: Share your poems flowing from the Kuytu app anonymously here and listen to the echo of your feelings.
features.fener_yolu_desc: Leave your lantern of sorrow anonymously to the darkness or support the lanterns of other lost souls.
features.ruhani_geyik_desc: Confide in the mystic deer, pour your heart out, and draw your daily oracle card to guide your path.
features.bahcem_desc: In this Plus-exclusive area, view your support statistics and whisper your desires to the Wishing Tree.
features.mistik_desc: Private telepathic DM box. Incoming whispers disappear into the darkness within 3 seconds, permanently deleted. Lanterns exclusive to you burn for 12 hours and then turn to ashes.
features.ruh_hali_desc: You are free to express yourself however you wish. Release your mood into the universe, whether it's through a text, a secret voice whisper, a photo, or a video.
features.rezonans_desc: Enter popular emotion rooms within your 500m aura. Review the daily collective aura analysis of your area and learn the mystic whisper of the day.

why.title: Why His?
why.p1: Because the secrets we hide inside only illuminate in the right darkness.
why.p2: Because every whisper waits for another soul vibrating on the same frequency.
why.p3: Because sometimes when we get lost in the dark, our path is lit by a lantern of sorrow lit by a stranger.
why.p4: His is not just a digital space... it is a mystical experience where souls touch each other with words.
why.quote: A place, a feeling, a trace.

kuytu_privacy.page_title: Kuytu: Sanctuary of Whispers – Privacy Policy
kuytu_privacy.intro: At Kuytu, we believe your inner world and whispers should remain exclusively yours. Therefore, our privacy policy is built upon the foundation of "absolute user control" and "serverless privacy".
kuytu_privacy.sec1_p: We guarantee that your journals, poems, emotional records, and personal data are strictly never uploaded to cloud servers, but are stored entirely and solely locally on your device.
kuytu_privacy.sec2_p: To use the Kuytu app, you are never asked to provide your name, email address, phone number, or any Personally Identifiable Information (PII), and such data is not collected.
kuytu_privacy.sec3_title: 3. Whispers to the Night and 24-Hour Global Anonymity:
kuytu_privacy.sec3_p: The anonymous text or voice recordings you share with other dwellers using the Whispers menu remain on our servers for a maximum of 24 hours. After 24 hours, they are permanently deleted without a trace.
kuytu_privacy.sec4_p: Except for the temporary shares made in the Whispers to the Night menu which are deleted after 24 hours, no user data (journals, poems, emotion graphs, etc.) is ever stored on our servers.
kuytu_privacy.sec5_title: 5. Silent Kindness Garden and Friday Table:
kuytu_privacy.sec5_p: Your records and plants in your silent kindness garden exist only on your local device. The statistics table published every Friday is completely anonymous; it reflects the total number of people doing kindness as a community, not who did what.
kuytu_privacy.sec6_p: The data you send to the AI (Google Gemini AI) infrastructure is kept completely confidential, processed solely for instant poetry/analysis generation, and never sold for commercial purposes.
kuytu_privacy.sec7_p: The microphone is only activated at the moment you wish to send a voice whisper. Background environment listening is never performed, and camera permission is not requested.
kuytu_privacy.sec8_p: The app does not access general files on your device in the background. Backups you take to prevent data loss occur through your device's secure file system entirely at your manual initiative.
kuytu_privacy.sec9_p: A random anonymous identifier (UUID) is created on your device so you can interact with whispers. This ID never matches your real-life identity.
kuytu_privacy.sec10_title: 10. Community Safety, Content Reporting, and Blocking:
kuytu_privacy.sec10_p: There is zero tolerance for profanity, violence, or harassment in User-Generated Content (UGC). You can instantly report disturbing content or block the related user with a single tap.
kuytu_privacy.sec11_p: If you share the poems you create in Kuytu on our sister app 'His', this data transfer occurs completely anonymously.
kuytu_privacy.sec12_title: 12. Kuytu Plus Subscriptions and Financial Data:
kuytu_privacy.sec12_p: Payments for premium features are processed entirely via the Apple App Store and Google Play infrastructure (via RevenueCat). Your credit card or financial information never reaches us.
kuytu_privacy.sec13_p: Google AdMob is used to support the free version. AdMob may use your device's Advertising ID to show you relevant advertisements.
kuytu_privacy.sec14_p: We cooperate with the legitimate requests of official authorities; however, since your journals are not stored in our system, the disclosure of non-existent data is technically impossible. Only the 24-hour whisper logs (if constituting a crime) can be reviewed.
kuytu_privacy.sec15_title: 15. International Data Transfer and Server Locations:
kuytu_privacy.sec15_p: Your 24-hour temporary whisper data is hosted encrypted in secure (Supabase) cloud infrastructures complying with international standards.
kuytu_privacy.sec16_title: 16. Deleting the App and Data Destruction:
kuytu_privacy.sec16_p: Since all your data is kept on your local device, the moment you uninstall the app from your device, all your data is instantly and irretrievably destroyed.
kuytu_privacy.sec17_title: 17. Apple App Store and Google Play Compliance Statement:
kuytu_privacy.sec17_p: This app has been developed to fully comply with all security, privacy, and community policies of the stores (Apple and Google) where it is published.
kuytu_privacy.sec18_title: 18. Comprehensive Rights of the Data Subject (KVKK & GDPR):
kuytu_privacy.sec18_p: Under KVKK (Turkey) and GDPR (Europe), users have the right to request the deletion of their data (Right to be Forgotten) and receive a copy of their data. However, since no personal data is stored on Kuytu servers, there is technically no cloud data to delete or transfer. All control remains strictly on your local device.
kuytu_privacy.sec19_title: 19. Reverse Engineering and CSAM (Child Abuse) Red Line:
kuytu_privacy.sec19_p: Copying the application's source codes, reverse engineering, or probing server vulnerabilities is strictly prohibited. Furthermore, CSAM (Child Sexual Abuse Material) and terrorism propaganda are our absolute red lines. If such severe illegal content is detected in the 24-hour temporary whisper feed, the associated anonymous device logs are immediately reported to the relevant international judicial authorities.
kuytu_privacy.sec20_p: Major changes in our privacy policy are notified within the app. For any data requests and questions, you can reach us at kuytu.destek@gmail.com.

his_privacy.intro: At HIS (Hisvera), the security and privacy of your personal data are of utmost importance to us. This Privacy Policy explains how your data is collected, processed, and protected.
his_privacy.sec1_p:
• a) Membership Info: We use Google Sign-In and Apple Sign-In to facilitate user experience. Only basic profile info (name, email, avatar) is securely collected.
  • b) User Content: Messages in your Telepathic DM are never stored on our servers (Supabase). Conversations in chat rooms are kept for only 12 hours and then permanently deleted; these messages are never shared with anyone or sold. Media content you add to your posts or lanterns (photos, videos, voice whispers) are stored on our servers; however, this data is kept completely secure, is not shared with third parties, and is never sold.
  • c) Purchase and Subscription Data: HIS Plus and HIS Pro purchases are processed directly by Google Play Store and Apple App Store billing. Your payment method is not seen or stored by us. Only transaction IDs and package info are synced via RevenueCat.
  • d) Push Notification Tokens: Unique device push tokens are stored on our Supabase server to deliver reactions. You can disable this in your settings.
his_privacy.sec2_p: Our app requires location access to add geographical context to your feeling shares on the map. Your location data is only retrieved at the exact moment of sharing; continuous background tracking is never performed, and data is not sold to third parties.
his_privacy.sec3_p: Camera and gallery access is requested so you can enrich your feelings with images. Uploaded photos are hosted on our servers. Inappropriate content can be reported and permanently deleted.
his_privacy.sec4_p: In-app purchases (HIS Plus and HIS Pro) are processed entirely via Google Play Store and Apple App Store. RevenueCat is used to verify your subscription. Only an anonymous User ID and purchase history are processed.
his_privacy.sec5_p: To keep the app free, we use the AdMob infrastructure. Our database and file storage operations are securely hosted on Supabase cloud servers.
his_privacy.sec6_p:
We enforce a zero-tolerance policy against Child Sexual Abuse Materials (CSAM) and content violating child safety:
  • Prohibited Content: No such text, image, audio, or link is allowed and will be removed instantly.
  • Reporting: Users can report via the app or email.
  • Legal Notification: Illegal content is immediately reported to authorities (e.g., NCMEC) and law enforcement; offending accounts are suspended.
his_privacy.sec7_title: 7. Data Security, Storage, and Deletion Rights
his_privacy.sec7_p: Your user data is stored on encrypted, secure servers. You can permanently delete your profile, lanterns, and all data from our servers at any time via your account settings.
his_privacy.sec8_p: Users continue to own the copyright of the feelings, photos, and texts they share. However, by sharing this content, they grant the His application a worldwide, royalty-free license to display this content within the platform.
his_privacy.sec9_title: 9. Data Sharing with Official Authorities (Legal Requests)
his_privacy.sec9_p: Your personal data and log records are never sold or shared with third parties. However, in the event of a court order or official legal request (subpoena), it may be shared with the relevant judicial authorities to fulfill our legal obligations.
his_privacy.sec10_p: Under KVKK and GDPR, you have the right to request a copy of your data (feelings, lanterns, and media content you shared) via email.
his_privacy.sec11_p: HIS is not responsible for the content or privacy practices of third-party links shared within the application. Any risk associated with clicking on these links belongs to the user.
his_privacy.sec12_p: HIS takes top-level security measures to protect user data (Supabase infrastructure). However, it cannot be held responsible for data loss caused by potential technical failures, cyber-attacks, or force majeure. Users are responsible for backing up content that is important to them.
his_privacy.sec13_title: 13. Comprehensive Rights of the Data Subject (GDPR)
his_privacy.sec13_p:
In accordance with GDPR and KVKK, all our users have the following rights:
  • Right of Access: To learn what data we process about you.
  • Right to Rectification: To request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data.
  • Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten): To request permanent deletion of all your data.
  • Right to Restriction: To pause the processing of your data in certain cases.
  • Right to Object: To object to data processing based on legitimate interests.
his_privacy.sec14_p: The His app uses global infrastructure. Your data (profile, messages, lanterns) is hosted on cloud servers located abroad (e.g., Supabase - US/EU data centers) which have very high security standards. By using our app, you explicitly consent to the transfer and secure storage of your data abroad in compliance with GDPR and relevant international laws.
his_privacy.sec15_p: We use various SDKs (Software Development Kits) and tracking technologies to improve app performance and ensure security. Google AdMob may be used for ad displays, RevenueCat for subscription management, and standard device identifiers (IDFA/AAID) for analytics. These technologies do not directly reveal your personal identity; they only collect anonymous, device-based statistics.
his_privacy.sec16_p: We take industry-standard measures (256-bit encryption) for your data security. However, in the event of unauthorized access or a cyberattack (data breach) on our systems, we commit to notifying directly affected users and relevant official Data Protection Authorities within 72 hours, in accordance with applicable laws.
his_privacy.sec17_p: AI features in our app, such as 'Spiritual Deer', process the texts you enter solely to generate instantaneous artistic or literary outputs. Your private data is not used to train our AI models. Furthermore, our systems do not use your personal data for 'automated decision-making' or algorithmic 'profiling' (e.g., credit scoring, employment) that would produce legal effects concerning you.
his_privacy.sec18_p: Your data is stored only for the duration required by its processing purposes. Chat room messages are deleted within 12 hours. When you delete your account, your data is instantly destroyed. However, legal obligations (e.g., purchase invoice records) may be kept encrypted in our archives for the statutory limitation periods prescribed by law.
his_privacy.sec19_p: Systemic (transactional) emails such as 'Forgot Password', 'Subscription Started / Thank You', security alerts, or policy updates may be sent to the email address you registered with the HIS app. These emails are a fundamental part of the service to ensure the secure operation of the app and your account. However, your explicit consent is required for optional marketing and promotional emails, and you reserve the right to unsubscribe at any time.
his_privacy.sec20_p: For any requests, complaints, and the exercise of your rights regarding our privacy policy, you can contact us 24/7 as the Data Controller at hisnoktasi@gmail.com.
